name: core.openwop.workflows.starters
description: Starter workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0190) — the simple-pipe on-ramp tier: short single-trigger→action recipes (webhook→notify, form→table, schedule→digest, fetch→store) that run in under a minute with zero connections, before you graduate to the AI-agent packs. Trigger-shaped starters begin with a core.trigger.* pass-through entry node: bind them to a live source with a trigger subscription (POST /v1/trigger-subscriptions — webhook, email, or form; RFC 0099) or a Schedule; on a manual run the trigger payload is empty, so bind a source to see them shine. External sends stay behind a human approval gate; in-app notifications are direct. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: openwop

chains.label: Webhook → Notification
chains.description: The hello-world pipe: any webhook event becomes an in-app notification. Run it manually to try the shape; bind a live source via the trigger-subscriptions API and every delivery notifies you with the payload.

webhookPath.description: URL path segment this workflow listens on (e.g. `ci-failure`).

chains.label: Form Submission → Table Row
chains.description: The classic form→spreadsheet shape: every form submission is appended as a row in a durable table, then you get a notification. Run it manually to try the shape; bind a live form source via the trigger-subscriptions API.

table.description: Durable table name the rows are appended to.

chains.label: Scheduled One-Line Digest
chains.description: A tiny recurring brief: on each scheduled run, write a one-paragraph digest on your topic and notify you. Pair it with a Schedule to make it recurring — the simplest taste of an AI step inside a pipe.

topic.default: a short daily focus note for the team

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for when this workflow runs (e.g. `0 9 * * 1` = Mondays 09:00).

config.systemPrompt: Write a single crisp paragraph (max 80 words) on: {{params.topic}}. Plain text, no preamble.

chains.label: Fetch URL → Blob Storage
chains.description: Save a file from any URL into blob storage and get notified with the stored reference — the classic save-the-file pipe.

url.description: The URL of the file to fetch and store.

chains.label: Verified Webhook Router
chains.description: A webhook pipe that checks the sender's signature first (Stripe / GitHub / Slack / raw HMAC — the secret stays host-side, never a parameter): verified events notify you; failed signatures are dropped. The safe way to wire third-party webhooks.

family.description: Signature family to verify: stripe, github, slack, or raw-hmac.

webhookPath.description: URL path segment this workflow listens on (e.g. `ci-failure`).

event.description: The verified webhook payload (failed signatures are dropped).

chains.label: Webhook → Summarize → Slack
chains.description: Turn any webhook event into a one-line summary and post it to Slack — behind a human approval, because it leaves the building. Approve a few, then decide if you want it always-on.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

webhookPath.description: URL path segment this workflow listens on (e.g. `ci-failure`).

config.systemPrompt: Summarize this event payload in one plain-text line a teammate can scan in Slack. No markdown, no preamble.

config.title: Approve this summary before it posts to Slack
